meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发智能体的特殊工作模式,加载预先设定的规则
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用 Codex 且希望它遵守你的自定义工作规则
copy.tagline_en: Trigger a special agent mode and load its predefined rules
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Codex and want it to follow your custom working rules.

howto.what: 装上后，一旦触发，Claude 会先输出“ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”，然后按固定纪律工作：先明确最终目标和验收标准，再写会失败的测试，实现到通过，最后在真实环境（命令行、浏览器、接口）里验证并截图留证；全程用待办清单和笔记记录进度。
howto.when: 当你的输入里出现“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式修这个 bug，先写失败测试再实现。
say.note: 会先证明 bug 存在，再修复到通过。

say.text: 进入 ulw 模式，先给任务分轻重再规划步骤。
say.note: 会先分类 LIGHT/HEAVY 并记录依据。

say.text: 开启 ultrawork，在真实浏览器里验证这个页面。
say.note: 会实际驱动浏览器验证并截图留证。

howto.what_en: When activated, Claude first prints "ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!", then sets a goal with success criteria, keeps a durable notepad, implements test-first, verifies on the real surface (HTTP/browser/terminal), and records evidence for each step, tracking progress via update_plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the prompt contains "ultrawork" or "ulw".

say_en.text: Fix this bug in ultrawork mode: write a failing test first, then implement.
say_en.note: Proves the bug exists, then turns it green.

say_en.text: Enter ulw mode, triage the task by tier, then plan.
Start ultrawork and verify this page in a real browser.
say_en.note: Drives a real browser and captures screenshots.
